rules.name: Symbol
rules.matchers: (y > 5 and y < 9 and not ghost) or (label matches "Symbol")

rules.name: Fn
rules.matchers: (y > 9 and y < 14 and not ghost) or (label matches "Fn")

rules.name: BT
rules.matchers: (y > 15 and y < 19 and not ghost) or (label matches "BT") and not (label matches "Layer")
